name: teacher-sab
description: A teaching system that works in any AI harness - opencode, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, pi, plain chat. The teach skill reads the learner's profile every session, probes before explaining, and spaces review across sessions. Pedagogy by amosblomqvist/learn (forked); harness-agnostic installer and improvements by K1NGS1LVER.

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:unit: bash test/unit-learning-policy.sh && bash test/unit-course-import.sh && bash test/unit-course-github.sh && bash test/unit-course-web.sh && bash test/unit-course-refresh.sh
scripts.test:integration: bash test/verify-harnesses.sh && bash test/integration-course-import.sh && bash test/integration-course-github.sh && bash test/integration-course-web.sh && bash test/integration-course-refresh.sh
scripts.test:e2e: bash test/e2e-install-flow.sh && bash test/e2e-course-import.sh && bash test/e2e-course-github.sh && bash test/e2e-course-web.sh && bash test/e2e-course-refresh.sh
